prompt: Make a small step-by-step demo for a fictional folding laptop stand. Show how to open the latch, raise the platform, and lock it at a new angle. Let me go forward, go back, and start over on my phone. Deliver one HTML file I can open directly.
expected_output: A standalone interactive HTML explainer with three recognizable mechanical states.
assertions: Inspect the settled raise and lock frames at 390 CSS pixels. The platform stays attached at its hinge, rises above the base, and remains fully visible.
Inspect the locked frame. The locking part meets its intended contact point, and the accessible description agrees with the visible diagram.
Check forward, back, and restart by keyboard. Check reduced motion and verify that all written instructions remain readable with JavaScript disabled.
